item.title: Cost of Living in Hughesdale Melbourne
item.description:
The cost of living in Hughesdale surprises some people. Whether that is a good or bad surprise depends on your budget.

Read our full Hughesdale suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Hughesdale Expensive?

Hughesdale sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Hughesdale, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.

item.title: Hughesdale — History and How It's Changed
item.description:
Hughesdale has reinvented itself multiple times. Each era left its mark, and you can still see them today.

See our full Hughesdale suburb guide for the current picture.

What Hughesdale Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Hughesdale was agricultural land and market gardens. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.

Like most of Melbourne, Hughesdale’s history is inseparable from the broader story of a city that grew outward from the Yarra in waves. This suburb was settled when Melbourne needed it — whether for housing workers, accommodating families, or providing a retreat from the city centre.
